evidence_quote: Net sales in our CPI segment increased by $1.8 billion, or 38% from fiscal year 2025, driven by a 29% increase in our Cloud and Cooling business and 61% growth in our Power business.

headline: AI compute capacity constrained by power and limited supplier base
statement: Alphabet discloses that scaling technical infrastructure is increasingly constrained by power, water, and land availability, with AI accelerator supply limited to a small number of qualified suppliers.
evidence_quote: Our ability to scale our technical infrastructure is increasingly constrained by the availability of power, water, and land... manufacturing and supply of servers and network equipment... particularly for specialized AI chips, is limited to a small number of qualified suppliers.

headline: Pending $32 billion acquisition of Wiz to bolster cloud security
statement: Alphabet entered a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz for $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, expected to close in 2026, integrating into Google Cloud.
evidence_quote: In March 2025, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz, a leading cloud security platform, for $32.0 billion, subject to closing adjustments, in an all-cash transaction.

headline: Global Banking & Markets revenue up 18% to $41.45 billion
statement: 2025 net revenues in Global Banking & Markets were $41.45 billion, an 18% increase from 2024, driven by higher investment banking fees and underwriting activity.
evidence_quote: Net revenues in Global Banking & Markets were $41.45 billion for 2025, 18% higher than 2024. Investment banking fees were $9.34 billion, 21% higher than 2024, primarily due to significantly higher net revenues in Advisory...

headline: Completed GMS acquisition for $5.5B to expand building materials distribution
statement: Home Depot completed the acquisition of GMS for approximately $5.5 billion, making it a wholly owned subsidiary to enhance its multi-category building materials distribution capabilities.
evidence_quote: the merger was completed on September 4, 2025. As a result of the merger, GMS became a direct subsidiary of SRS and an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

headline: HPE completes Juniper Networks acquisition for $13.4 billion
statement: HPE completed the merger with Juniper Networks on July 2, 2025, paying $40.00 per share for approximately $13.4 billion in cash consideration.
evidence_quote: On July 2, 2025, the Company completed the Juniper Networks, Inc. (“Juniper Networks”) merger... HPE agreed to pay $40.00 per share... representing a cash consideration of approximately $13.4 billion.

headline: Intel 14A foundry node at risk of pause without external customer
statement: Intel may pause or discontinue its Intel 14A node if it fails to secure a significant external foundry customer, potentially shifting manufacturing to third parties like TSMC.
evidence_quote: We announced that if we are unable to secure a significant external foundry customer for Intel 14A, we may pause or discontinue our pursuit of Intel 14A and successor leading-edge process technologies.

headline: Major GPU fleet expansion to 10.9k units by year-end 2025
statement: IREN procured approximately 10.9k NVIDIA B200, B300, and GB300 GPUs to be installed at Prince George by end of 2025, significantly expanding AI compute capacity.
evidence_quote: procured... approximately 5.5k NVIDIA B200 GPUs, 2.3k NVIDIA B300 GPUs and 1.2k NVIDIA GB300 GPUs to be installed... by the end of calendar year 2025

headline: Intelligent Infrastructure revenue surges 34% driven by cloud and data center demand
statement: The Intelligent Infrastructure segment, which includes AI infrastructure, saw a 34% net revenue increase, with cloud/data center revenues up 30% and capital equipment up 10%.
evidence_quote: Intelligent Infrastructure segment net revenue increased 34% primarily due to: (i) a 30% increase in revenues from existing customers within our cloud and data center infrastructure business and (ii) a 10% increase in revenues from existing customers within our capital equipment business.

headline: Divestiture of R&LC HVAC business generated $5.6 billion in net proceeds
statement: The company completed the sale of its Residential and Light Commercial HVAC business to Robert Bosch GmbH for approximately $5.6 billion after tax and expenses.
evidence_quote: The Company received net cash proceeds related to the sale of its R&LC HVAC business of approximately $5.6 billion after tax...

headline: Stelara biosimilar erosion accelerates
statement: Second largest product Stelara accounted for 6.5% of 2025 revenue, with continued biosimilar launches negatively impacting sales.
evidence_quote: Sales of the Company’s second largest product, STELARA (ustekinumab) accounted for approximately 6.5% of the Company's total revenues for fiscal 2025.

headline: China export controls reduced revenue share and backlog
statement: U.S. export restrictions on semiconductors to China caused a reduction in backlog, required return of deposits, and decreased revenue from Chinese customers to 33% in FY2025 from 43% in FY2024.
evidence_quote: Our revenue from sales of products and provision of services to customers in China was 33%, 43% and 27% for fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively

headline: F-35 program represents 27% of consolidated sales
statement: The F-35 program is the company's largest program, accounting for 27% of total consolidated sales in 2025, creating significant customer concentration risk.
evidence_quote: The F-35 program... is our largest program and represented 27% of our total consolidated sales in 2025.

headline: China export controls and trade disputes pose material risk
statement: The company discloses that sales to China are impacted by export license requirements and that trade disputes could materially adversely affect future revenue and profits.
evidence_quote: A significant trade dispute... could have a materially adverse impact on our future revenue and profits... export licenses... has limited and could in the future further limit the market

headline: Middle East conflict disrupts critical semiconductor material supply
statement: Iranian drone strikes halted helium production in Qatar, and bromine supplies from Israel/Jordan are at risk, impacting wafer fabrication.
evidence_quote: Qatar accounts for more than one‑third of the world’s helium production, and recent Iranian drone strikes halted operations at major helium facilities.
